balls.name: Tour ball
balls.source: Coefficient form and constants: dimple 'TOUR' (github.com/divotmaker/dimple, MIT/Apache-2.0), calibrated by its author to the TrackMan 2024 PGA Tour averages and a 1,178-shot set; spin decay 4 %/s (dimple, openflight). Mass and diameter: Rules of Golf limits.

balls.name: Launch-monitor fit (Ferguson et al. 2022)
balls.source: Ferguson, McNally & McPhee (2022), ISEA, doi:10.5703/1288284317493: Cd and Cl quadratic in the spin parameter, held above S = 0.75.
